title: Rehab Agent session record
description: One folder per session (docs/hardware.md protocol step 7). No direct identifiers: person_ref is pseudonymous.

person_ref.description: Pseudonymous reference only. Never a name or medical record number.

synthetic.description: True for example/test data. Must be false for real sessions.

twin_tier.description: docs/accuracy.md tiers. Tier travels with the data.

proof_event.description: e.g. LED flash / hand clap at session start

accuracy_layers.description: Per docs/accuracy.md: status of each layer for this person/session.

error.description: Measured error with units, e.g. 'joint-centre <= 4 mm vs MRI'

breathing.description: (audit, breathing programme) Per docs/research-breathing-tracking.md. Diaphragm motion is INFERRED from surface/compartment signals unless directly measured by ultrasound - the label must travel with the data. Asynchrony values are screening flags for clinician review (D-03), never diagnoses.

compartment_volume_share_pct.description: Relative contribution to tidal volume by compartment (sums to ~100)

thoracoabdominal_phase_angle_deg.description: Rib-cage vs abdomen phase angle; 0 = synchronous, 180 = paradoxical

end_expiratory_volume_drift_ml.description: Drift of end-expiratory level over the recording (air-trapping / relaxation marker); only if calibrated

diaphragm_status.description: inferred = rendered from surface signal; ultrasound-measured = excursion/thickening directly observed

screening_flags.description: e.g. 'thoracoabdominal asynchrony - clinician review'. Screening only.
